summary.id: VIP+ kini tersedia untuk Windows dan kompatibel dengan Minecraft Bedrock 26.60. Pembaruan ini membangun ulang Material Bin lintas platform serta menyempurnakan motion blur, bayangan, kabut volumetrik, godrays, refleksi, air, dan efek hujan.
summary.en: VIP+ is now available for Windows and is compatible with Minecraft Bedrock 26.60. This update rebuilds the cross-platform Material Bin and improves motion blur, shadows, volumetric fog, godrays, reflections, water, and rain effects.

warning.id: Versi ini memiliki masalah yang diketahui, termasuk teks sign yang tidak muncul dan tampilan Warden yang bermasalah. HynisiOS tidak disarankan untuk versi ini.
warning.en: This release has known issues, including missing sign text and incorrect Warden appearance. HynisiOS is not recommended for this release.

items.id: Raiden Visuals VIP+ kini tersedia untuk Windows.
items.en: Raiden Visuals VIP+ is now available for Windows.

items.id: Kompatibel dengan Minecraft Bedrock versi 26.60.
items.en: Compatible with Minecraft Bedrock version 26.60.

items.id: Material Bin dibuat ulang dari awal agar dapat dibangun untuk beberapa platform.
items.en: The Material Bin was rebuilt from scratch to support builds for multiple platforms.

heading.id: Material Bin yang Dibuat Ulang dan Ditambahkan
heading.en: Rebuilt and Added Material Bin Materials

items.en: Actor materials: ActorBannerForwardPBR, ActorBannerPrepass, ActorForwardPBR, ActorGlintForwardPBR, ActorGlintPrepass, ActorMultiTextureForwardPBR, ActorMultiTexturePrepass, ActorPatternForwardPBR, ActorPatternGlintForwardPBR, ActorPatternGlintPrepass, ActorPatternPrepass, ActorPrepass, ActorTintForwardPBR, ActorTintPrepass.

items.en: Deferred and post-processing: ColorPostProcessing, DeferredMixedResolutionCaustics, DeferredMixedResolutionLightingPrepass, DeferredMixedResolutionSurfaceRadiance, DeferredShading, DeferredShadingBase, DeferredTiledMixedRes, DeferredWater.

items.en: Items and meshes: ItemInHandForwardPBR, ItemInHandForwardPBRGlint, ItemInHandForwardPBRTextured, ItemInHandPrepass, ItemInHandPrepassGlint, ItemInHandPrepassTextured, MeshFallbackForwardPBR, MeshFallbackPrepass, SingleBlockForwardPBR, SingleBlockPrepass.

items.en: Particles, render chunks, and other effects: ParticleForwardPBR, ParticlePrepass, PopulateVolume, RenderChunkForwardPBR, RenderChunkPrepass, ScreenSpaceReflections, TextureShiftRenderChunkPrepass, Upscaling, VolumeScattering, VolumetricsShadows, WaterExtinction.

items.id: Motion Blur diubah menjadi Rotate Only.
items.en: Motion Blur is now Rotate Only.

items.id: Hard Shadows kini 100% tanpa blur, bukan bayangan pixelated seperti versi vanilla.
items.en: Hard Shadows are now completely blur-free, rather than pixelated like vanilla shadows.

items.id: Volumetric Fogs tetap terlihat di area belakang arah matahari.
items.en: Volumetric Fogs remain visible in areas behind the sun direction.

items.id: Godrays dan Light Shaft dibuat jauh lebih panjang, tidak memudar, dan diperkuat 4x.
items.en: Godrays and Light Shafts are much longer, do not fade, and are 4x stronger.

items.id: Refleksi dibuat lebih bersih, ringan, dan tajam tanpa artefak visual yang mengganggu.
items.en: Reflections are cleaner, lighter, and sharper, with fewer distracting visual artifacts.

items.id: Air dibuat lebih transparan dan Caustics dioptimalkan.
items.en: Water is more transparent and Caustics have been optimized.

items.id: Menambahkan efek terrain basah saat hujan atau badai serta efek genangan air.
items.en: Added wet terrain during rain or storms, along with puddle effects.

items.id: Waving Grass dan Leaves dinonaktifkan sementara karena belum mendukung texture pack HD.
items.en: Waving Grass and Leaves are temporarily disabled because HD texture packs are not supported.

items.id: Batas maksimal Render Chunk ditingkatkan menjadi 256.
items.en: The maximum Render Chunk limit has been increased to 256.

items.id: Mode beta/preview dihapus dari subpack VIP+.
items.en: The beta/preview mode has been removed from the VIP+ subpack.

items.id: Ray Marching SSR disamakan untuk Android dan Windows. Pengaturan bawaan dipilih agar perbandingan beban dengan Vibrant Visuals original lebih jelas.
items.en: Ray Marching SSR is now consistent on Android and Windows. The default setting is intended to make performance comparisons with original Vibrant Visuals clearer.

items.id: Item, shield, dan armor yang memiliki enchant kini menyala dalam kegelapan.
items.en: Enchanted items, shields, and armor now glow in the dark.

items.id: Teks tidak muncul pada sign.
items.en: Text does not appear on signs.

items.id: Warden terlihat hitam dan mengilap.
items.en: The Warden appears black and shiny.

items.id: Motion Blur tidak lagi mendeteksi perpindahan entity atau posisi kamera saat diam; hanya rotasi yang terdeteksi karena keterbatasan material upscaling.
items.en: Motion Blur no longer detects entity movement or camera position changes while stationary; only rotation is detected due to an upscaling material limitation.

items.id: Dengan Action & Stuff, Motion Blur penuh dapat menampakkan masking di tepi terrain (misalnya pohon dan langit) serta membuat pemain third-person tetap buram saat diam.
items.en: With Action & Stuff, full Motion Blur can reveal masking at terrain edges (such as trees against the sky) and keep the third-person player blurred while stationary.

items.id: Dapat muncul outline pada rumput atau texture transparan yang menghadap matahari, terutama saat sunset.
items.en: An outline may appear on grass or transparent textures facing the sun, especially at sunset.

items.id: Pada sudut orbit tertentu, bayangan pada tanaman petals dapat terlihat belang.
items.en: At certain orbit angles, shadows on petal plants may appear uneven.

items.id: Pada jarak render chunk yang lebih luas, terrain jauh dapat tertutup kabut dan tampilan air mungkin tidak sinkron dengan kabut karena keterbatasan Minecraft Bedrock.
items.en: At longer render chunk distances, distant terrain may be obscured by fog and water may not align with the fog due to Minecraft Bedrock limitations.

items.id: HynisiOS tidak disarankan untuk versi ini.
items.en: HynisiOS is not recommended for this release.

summary.id: Pembaruan VIP+ untuk Android dengan Motion Blur, Waving Grass/Leaves, optimalisasi SSR, dan pembaruan UI opsi.
summary.en: VIP+ update for Android featuring Motion Blur, Waving Grass/Leaves, SSR optimizations, and an options UI update.

warning.id: Versi Windows tidak mendapatkan pembaruan Screen Effect dan optimalisasi SSR.
warning.en: The Windows version does not receive the Screen Effect update or SSR optimizations.

items.id: Menambahkan FX Motion Blur. Atur upscaling ke TAAU, lalu turunkan resolusi di bawah native agar Motion Blur aktif.
items.en: Added FX Motion Blur. Set upscaling to TAAU, then lower the resolution below native to enable Motion Blur.

items.id: Motion Blur menggunakan 6 samples dengan sapuan/strength yang cukup kecil.
items.en: Motion Blur uses 6 samples with a relatively low sweep/strength.

items.id: Tidak mendukung upscaling Bilinear atau tanpa upscaling (Native).
items.en: Bilinear upscaling and no upscaling (Native) are not supported.

items.id: Hanya mendeteksi pergerakan kamera dan entity (kecuali First Person).
items.en: Detects camera and entity movement only (except in First Person).

items.id: Menambahkan efek angin untuk rumput, daun, dan tumbuhan lain.
items.en: Added wind effects for grass, leaves, and other plants.

items.id: Isu yang diketahui: iron bars, pintu, dan block yang seharusnya tidak bergoyang ikut bergoyang.
items.en: Known issue: iron bars, doors, and blocks that should not sway may also move.

items.id: Mengoptimalkan Screen Space Reflection (SSR) agar lebih ringan, tajam, dan bersih.
items.en: Optimized Screen Space Reflection (SSR) to be lighter, sharper, and cleaner.

items.id: Kompatibel dengan Minecraft Bedrock versi 26.52.
items.en: Compatible with Minecraft Bedrock version 26.52.

items.id: Mengoptimalkan bayangan pada Material Bin.
items.en: Optimized shadows in Material Bin.

items.id: Memperbaiki SSR Ultra untuk Android sehingga area pantulannya terlihat lebih luas.
items.en: Improved Ultra SSR for Android, with a wider visible reflection area.

items.id: Konfigurasi Ultra untuk kabut volumetrik di Android kini disamakan dengan PC.
items.en: The Ultra volumetric fog configuration on Android now matches PC.

items.id: Menghapus tombol keramat yang membuat game tidak bisa dikeluarkan.
items.en: Removed the troublesome button that could prevent the game from being closed.

items.id: Isu yang diketahui: teks resolusi pada upscaling bisa menghilang.
items.en: Known issue: the resolution text under upscaling may disappear.

items.id: Happy Update ^^
items.en: Happy Update ^^
